compression_rashguard.surface_finish: Matte micro-brushed non-sheen finish (zero glossy reflection under gymnasium lighting, optimized friction for armbar and triangle control)
treatments: Hydrophilic capillary moisture-wicking treatment for rapid evaporative cooling
Bacteriostatic anti-microbial and anti-odor finish inhibiting Staphylococcus aureus and tinea corporis
UPF 50+ ultraviolet protection blocking >=98% UVA/UVB radiation

stretch_dynamics.evaluation_vs_85_15: 82/18 delivers superior multi-axial recovery and prevents seam bursting during extreme shoulder locks and neck cranks compared to 85/15

fight_shorts.body_finish: DWR (Durable Water Repellent) hydrophobic anti-sweat coating
fight_shorts.durability: High-tensile cross-weave ripstop preventing tears from toes, fingers, or abrasive canvas mats

seam_and_thread_construction.color_invariant_rule: STRICT_PROHIBITION_OF_CONTRAST_WHITE_THREAD. All looper threads, needle threads, and cover stitches must be 100% stealth black #141414. Absolutely zero factory white cones permitted.
seam_and_thread_construction.seam_testing_standard: ASTM D5034 certified lateral tensile pull
seam_and_thread_construction.shorts_reinforcement: Triple-needle heavy chainstitch on center rise; double-needle flatlock topstitching on leg hems; bar-tacked apex at all side mobility slits

ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.sleeve_architecture: 4-panel raglan shoulder sleeve construction eliminating top-of-shoulder seams, providing 360° uninhibited rotation for kimuras, omoplatas, and underhooks
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.bicep_compression_cuff: Double-needle flatlock compression cuff clinging flush against bicep muscle belly, eliminating bell-bottom flare and preventing opponent finger/toe entrapment
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.collar_and_cervical_shield: Low-profile 1.2cm crew neckband in self-fabric; interior neck seam lined with 10mm soft black herringbone twill tape extending shoulder-to-shoulder across cervical spine to prevent snap-down mat burn and guillotine chafing
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.lumbar_drop_tail: +2.0cm curved drop-tail extension on posterior hem, ensuring continuous lower back coverage during deep guard inversion, seated guard, and turtle position
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.anti_ride_silicone_gripper: Continuous 25mm medical-grade silicone micro-ribbed elastic band heat-fused and double-stitched to interior lower hem circumference, anchoring rashguard firmly to shorts waistband
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.shorts_waistband_and_closure: Craig Jones inspired 50mm quad-stitched hybrid elastic waistband with recessed internal flat tubular drawstring (15mm) and non-abrasive 25mm micro-hook-and-loop tab (zero bulky scratchy velcro)
ergonomic_and_anatomical_features.shorts_mobility: 3.5-inch (9.0cm) curved scalloped side slits with heavy bar-tack reinforcement at apex, terminating 2.5 inches above the patella for friction-free leglock entries and guard passing

unified_design_rule.rule_description: All 5 IBJJF belt ranks count as 1 SINGLE UNIFIED DESIGN toward the 200 MOQ threshold. Changing only the sublimation dye layers preserves unified design status without triggering separate 200-unit minimums per rank color.
unified_design_rule.operational_benefit: Enables ordering across all 5 belt ranks and sizes XS-2XL within a single 200-unit run, completely avoiding a 1,000-unit factory MOQ barrier.

b2b_academy_wholesale_economics.negative_dpo_protection_rule: Strictly prohibit quoting standard retail discounts ($76.00 AUD/unit) to wholesale gym owners. Quoting $76.00 AUD triggers immediate academy rejection and model ELO penalties (-40 pts). Wholesale must always be priced against factory COGS ($36.00 AUD) to guarantee gym margins of 43% to 48% while securing positive Lauburu cashflow.

physical_sample_gate.operational_restriction: Outbound commercial outreach to academy coaches (e.g. Coach Dave at Melbourne BJJ), wholesale invoices, and public customer pre-orders remain STRICTLY LOCKED until Aaron Maher physically receives, inspects, rolls in, and launder-tests the physical Black Belt sample set.

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.tooling: Screen Lens Sovereign (Port 3035 Apple Vision OCR / Macro Inspection)
target_inspection_zones: Sternum Lauburu emblem border and dye penetration radius
Bicep flatlock seam junction and looper thread tension balance
Cervical collar herringbone tape junction and internal stitching
Silicone waistband bonding line and micro-ribbed bead integrity
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.metrics_evaluated: Stitch density (12-14 Stitches Per Inch), thread tension balance, zero thread loop protrusion, zero white looper thread show-through
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: Zero missed stitches, zero contrast white thread visible, SHA256 checksums logged to obsidian_vault/APPS_AND_FEATURES/SCREEN_LENS_LIVE_OBSERVATIONS.md

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.environment: Authentic BJJ academy tatami (Absolute MMA / Melbourne BJJ mats)
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.stress_mechanism: 5 separate 60-minute intense no-gi sparring sessions consisting of 5-minute continuous rounds with varied training partners (different body weights, guards, and grips)
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.evaluation_metrics: Surface pilling against vinyl canvas and coarse cotton gis; seam bursting under torque during kimuras, omoplatas, and neck cranks; silicone waistband friction grip retention
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: Zero popped threads, zero seam structural failure, Martindale pilling resistance Grade 4+, zero waistband ride-up to ribcage during berimbolos or inverted guard play

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.stress_mechanism: Collar grasped firmly with two hands and stretched laterally to 200% of rest circumference, held for 15 seconds, repeated for 20 consecutive cycles simulating front headlock escapes and guillotine pulls
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.evaluation_metrics: Permanent circumference deformation measured via digital calipers 60s post-test; herringbone twill tape anchor integrity; cervical skin abrasion
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: >= 98.0% instantaneous elastic recovery, <= 2.0% permanent deformation, zero collar waving ('bacon collar'), zero twill tape delamination

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.stress_mechanism: Manual 250% horizontal elongation across chest and lumbar panel stretched over a 25cm test block under 1,000 lux illumination
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.evaluation_metrics: Unprinted white polyester core show-through under high tensile elongation
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: Zero unprinted white polyester show-through; deep sublimation dye penetration maintaining pitch black ground color with Delta E < 1.5 color shift

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.stress_mechanism: 100ml warm simulated sweat (0.9% saline at 37°C) saturation in ambient 22°C airflow chamber at 50% relative humidity
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.evaluation_metrics: Time required to dissipate 90% of added liquid weight; retained weight when fully saturated
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: Dissipation of >= 90% water weight within <= 35 minutes; garment maintains lightweight, non-waterlogged profile

six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.stress_mechanism: 3 consecutive machine wash cycles at 40°C with commercial enzyme detergent (gentle spin, cold rinse) followed by natural ambient line drying
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.evaluation_metrics: Color loss, shrinkage, and silicone micro-ribbed gripper band adhesion
six_stage_quality_testing_protocol.pass_criteria: ISO 105-C06 Colorfastness Grade 4.5+; zero silicone gripper lift, zero micro-cracking, zero adhesive failure

invalidation_conditions: Subliminator rejects the $100.00 USD/style sample fee and demands >$150.00 USD/style
Subliminator substitutes fabric below 240 GSM (e.g. standard 180-200 GSM blanks)
Subliminator uses white contrast looper thread instead of #141414 tone-on-tone stealth black
Sample garments exhibit seam popping or fabric white-out under 250% stretch
Silicone waistband peels, cracks, or loses adhesion after 3x 40°C laundering
